summary_md: **pcinlife ([@pcinlife](https://x.com/pcinlife/status/2115435101643592159))** ported the Mia **Qwen 3.8 FP4** build to Windows 11 ARM64 (native MSVC, 17 merged patches, load time 257 s to 71 s), but notes it is still slower than on Linux DGX Spark; code is in the edisonchan/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-NVFP4-Windows-ARM64 repo.

referenced_urls.title: GitHub - edisonchan/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-NVFP4-Windows-ARM64: Windows 11 ARM64 port of the MiaAI-Lab Qwen3.8-Flash-Next NVFP4 recipe: TensorFold v1.1.4 engine, the 17 recipe patches merged, MSVC port fixes, and a load pipeline that takes model loading from 257 s to 71 s.

relevance: A data point on OS choice for GB10-class hardware: Linux still wins for FP4 Qwen inference.
